title: U.S. Army Awards Rune Technologies $2M for Predictive Logistics Platform | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies unveils AI-driven logistics system.
body_markdown:
# AI-Driven Logistics System


Rune Technologies has unveiled its new AI-driven logistics and supply-chain tracking system, designed to optimize military logistics operations. This innovative platform utilizes artificial intelligence to track supplies and equipment with unprecedented accuracy.


> "Our system allows military personnel to track ammunition like an Amazon package," said a Rune Technologies spokesperson.


This advancement is set to transform how the military approaches logistics and supply chain management.
